name: Dumbbell Stability Ball Single-Arm Fly
steps: Lie with your upper back and head supported on a stability ball, feet planted firmly on the floor, and hips elevated in a strong bridge.
Hold the dumbbell above your chest with your palm facing inward, your elbow softly bent and your free hand on your hip.
Open your loaded arm out to the side in a slow arc until your upper arm is roughly level with your torso.
Contract your chest to bring the dumbbell back above your midline, and switch arms after completing one side.
tips: Keep your hips high and square so the off-center load does not tip the ball.
Use a moderate weight and control the stretch rather than letting gravity pull your shoulder down.
